fields.description: What the cashier asks for — «Bebida», «Pan», «Extras». The options below name this group to join it.
fields.label: Group

fields.description: Picks the customer MUST make. 0 makes the group optional (extras).
fields.label: Min Picks

fields.description: Picks the customer MAY make. The same option can be picked more than once while this allows it («2 panes» = 2 conchas).
fields.label: Max Picks

fields.description: Optional. Every sellable item in this Item Group (and its subgroups) becomes an option at no extra charge, so a new drink on the menu joins the combo without editing it. Rows in the Options table still win: use them for upcharges and defaults.
fields.label: Any Item From
